description: Mechanical guardrails for agent sessions. These deny the actions the instruction layer forbids, so a compliant agent is never blocked and a non-compliant one cannot proceed. Authoritative control still rests with branch protection, required checks, least-privilege tokens, and the human merge signal.

preToolUse.name: deny-dangerous-actions
preToolUse.description: Blocks merges, pushes to main, destructive commands, credential reads, and guardrail edits.

postToolUse.name: audit-tool-use
postToolUse.description: Appends a sanitized record of every tool invocation to the local audit trail.

subagentStop.name: record-subagent-verdict
subagentStop.description: Captures each subagent's terminal verdict so the gate ledger can cite it.

errorOccurred.name: record-error-class
errorOccurred.description: Records the error class and the tool that raised it. Never records payloads.

sessionEnd.name: emit-session-summary
sessionEnd.description: Writes a schema-checked summary of the session's tool use, denials, and errors.

notes: The audit directory is git-ignored. It is a local forensic trail, not a committed artifact.
Hooks must complete within 5 seconds, parse stdin defensively, and never echo a matched secret.
